summary: The diff clearly adds a full COGS frontend module (Items/Purchases/Sales/Summary tabs) and wires COGS into the Dashboard and Reports UI. However, the backend COGS CRUD and calculation endpoints required to support these screens are not evidenced in the provided backend diff excerpt (backend/main.mo is truncated before any COGS endpoints appear). The diff also includes several unrelated frontend changes (branding/footer, category auto-seeding, payment method constants) that were not requested as part of the COGS feature.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add backend data models and CRUD endpoints for COGS inventory items (name, default unit cost, optional vendor linkage) with per-user ownership enforcement, vendor existence checks, and basic validation.
missing_requirements.reason: While COGS item types/storage and migration fields are shown, the diff excerpt does not show any create/update/delete/list endpoints, nor the required validation and vendor-id existence trapping logic.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add backend data models and CRUD endpoints for COGS purchases with ownership enforcement and validation (positive quantity, non-negative costs), including optional vendor linkage.
missing_requirements.reason: COGS purchase types/storage and migration fields are shown, but no purchase CRUD endpoints or validation/authorization logic is evidenced in the provided backend diff excerpt.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add backend data models and CRUD endpoints for COGS sales with ownership enforcement and validation (positive quantity).
missing_requirements.reason: COGS sale types/storage and migration fields are shown, but no sales CRUD endpoints or validation/authorization logic is evidenced in the provided backend diff excerpt.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement backend COGS calculation endpoints for total COGS over a time window and monthly trend time series, with deterministic documented logic and safe handling of missing purchase history.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend calls hooks for total and trends, but the backend diff excerpt does not show any COGS calculation endpoints, time-bucketing, determinism comments, or safe handling rules.

hallucinated_features.description: Restaurant categories auto-seeding logic added to the React Query categories hook.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest is specific to COGS tracking and does not request category seeding behavior changes.

hallucinated_features.description: Application branding/footer attribution changes (e.g., branded as "FoodBooks", added SGmultimediagroup.com attribution).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by any COGS requirement (REQ-1..REQ-7).

hallucinated_features.description: Changes to Expenses and Revenue pages (validation, table display enhancements, owner fallback handling).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by the COGS feature requirements; these are unrelated functional changes.
